description: Wonderwhales XAU 2-mode demo execution (ADR 0009): one guarded broker position driven by PinePort\Wonderwhales closed-bar signals in Scalp (M15/M5/M1) or Swing (W1/D1/H1) mode, with mandatory SL/TP, rule-based break-even and trailing, a persistent daily/weekly/drawdown guard and a mandatory parity gate. Execution enabled by default on demo (ADR 0006); set InpEnableExecution=false for a dry-run. InpRequireParity=true blocks entries until Pine<->MT5 parity is proven. Demo account or Strategy Tester only; real accounts are rejected at OnInit.

assumptions.account: demo or Strategy Tester only; real/contest accounts are rejected at OnInit (ExecContextAllowed -> INIT_FAILED). InpDemoOnly must stay true.
assumptions.modes: one magic 25008001; WW2_SCALP reads M15/M5/M1, WW2_SWING reads W1/D1/H1; the position stores the mode it was opened with and is managed by that stored mode.
assumptions.signal: PinePort\Wonderwhales buffers read on the last closed bar (shift=1); PSAR/EMA/ATR come from the indicator, never recomputed in the EA.
assumptions.parity: InpRequireParity=true blocks every entry with reason=parity_blocked until Pine<->MT5 parity is proven; trades taken with parity off are not a valid strategy result.
assumptions.stops: initial SL = confirmed swing plus an ATR buffer (fallback = a multiple of ATR); floored by InpMinStopPoints, capped by InpMaxStopPoints, checked against the broker stop level.
assumptions.take_profit: mandatory at InpTakeProfitR times the initial risk; the SWING mode additionally requires InpTakeProfitR >= InpSwingRrMin.
assumptions.trailing: break-even (with an optional cost buffer), structure/PSAR/ATR/step candidates are filtered and only the best is applied; the stop only tightens and R is always measured from the stored initial SL.
assumptions.sizing: InpRiskPercent of equity at the initial stop via OrderCalcProfit (ExecCalcProfit), floored to the volume step and capped by InpMaxExposure; a signal whose minimum lot would exceed the budget is skipped, never rounded up.
assumptions.locks: InpMaxDailyLossPct / InpMaxWeeklyLossPct / InpMaxDrawdownPct / InpMaxConsecutiveLosses gate entries and are persisted; daily/weekly locks reopen on a new server day/week, drawdown and kill switch stay until restart.
assumptions.journal: the 18-column SimLogger schema is unchanged; R, SL, trailing reason and per-timeframe EMA/PSAR/ATR go to the separate telemetry CSV.
assumptions.kill_switch: create WONDERWHALES_XAU_2MODE_DEMO_STOP.txt in MQL5/Files to close the position and stop entries until restart after the file is removed.
assumptions.results: demo execution is an operational check, not a performance or live-readiness claim; no profit is promised. Status NOT_RUN until a real journal exists.
